Dear Sir/ Madam, 
 
Update On Analyst Meet/Earnings call: Audio Recording 
 
In continuation to our earlier intimation Ref. No. IRC/100/2026-27 dated 14.07.2026 
and Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Clause 15 of Para A of Part A of Schedule III 
and Regulation 46(2)(o) of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015 as amended read with the guidance note of stock exchanges 
dated July 29, 2022 on disclosures pertaining to Investors meet, we wish to inform that 
the Bank has conducted an Analyst Meet/Earnings call on Monday, July 20, 2026 at 
17:30 (IST) to discuss the financial performance of the Bank for the Quarter ended 
June 30, 2026.  
 
The audio recording of aforementioned Analyst meet/earnings call is uploaded on 
Bank’s website and same can be accessed through following link:  
 
 https://www.iob.bank.in/documents/d/guest/10045036 
 
This is for your information and appropriate dissemination. 
    
 
 
Yours faithfully, 
 
 
 
Raghuram Mallela 
Deputy General Manager/ 
Company Secretary & Compliance Officer 
RAGHURAM 
MALLELA
Digitally signed by 
RAGHURAM MALLELA
